paragraphs: R. Chananyah, in R. Yehudah's name. Before R. Mana, in R. Yudan's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Tamid Nishchat; Horayot, chapter 2. R. Chananyah, R. Bun bar Kahana, and R. Zeira, in Chizkiyah's name: Jerusalem Kiddushin, chapter 1, halakhah 5. He was leaning on R. Chiyya bar Abba of Tzipporin and saw the people running to hear R. Yochanan's exposition. He rejoiced that he saw R. Yochanan expound in his lifetime, who had apparently learned all aggadah from him [the relative clause is compressed]: Jerusalem Horayot, chapter 3, halakhah 7. See R. Chiyya bar Abba above: there is a scribal error there, and at the end of chapter 2 of Bava Metzia. R. Yehudah ben Pazi, in R. Yochanan's name: Jerusalem Sukkah, chapter 1. And R. Yehoshua bar Zidal. Chananyah and R. Yonatan asked R. Menachem Talmaya. In R. Pinchas's name: Maaserot, chapter 3; Jerusalem Kiddushin, chapter 1. In Shmuel's name: beginning of chapter 2 of Orlah. In R. Shmuel bar Yitzchak's name: Jerusalem Talmud, end of HaMatznia.
